title: Test Review diff reading's data logic directly and drop "mounted" from frontend test names

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-413#reduce-review-diff-reading-to-logic-cases, revision e92a709785b7a8c9071a892af037a719c809ad4f

Verdict: Confirmed missing test path, within the checks examined below.

Promise (commitment 4.2): a rename from `old.txt` to `new.ts` selects TypeScript from the new path, and `new.txt` renamed from `old.ts` selects none.

Fault: in dashboard/src/StoryReviewFileDiff.tsx line 104, `path={file.path}` was changed to pass `file.oldPath` when present, else `file.path`. This was a one-line scratch edit. Fixtures and assertions were left as they were.

Checks examined, with what each did under the fault:
- dashboard/frontend-tests/review/story-review-diff-grammar-selection.spec.ts (Vitest, 36 cases). Passed. Its rename cases call only `diffLanguage(path)`. `oldPath` appears only in the case title, so the cases never reach the component that chooses which path to pass.
- dashboard/frontend-tests/review/story-review-diff-syntax-intent-hints.spec.ts (Playwright, 2 tests). Passed. Its rename case `legacy/run` → `scripts/setup-renamed.test` does go through StoryReviewFileDiff. But neither path has a recognised extension, so the Intent hint "shell" still applies under the fault and the `if` token still appears. This journey cannot tell the two paths apart.
- dashboard/frontend-tests/review/story-review-note-context.spec.ts (Playwright, 1 test). Passed. Its rename is `old-name.ts` → `new-name.ts`, which selects the same grammar on both sides, and it makes no token assertion.
- Other specs: the other styled-diff frontend specs (language-colours, styled-rendering, and others) mount StyledFileDiff directly with a path, so they bypass this fault. A grep found no token or syntax assertions in e2e/review/*.ts.

Independent witness: a scratch spec, dashboard/frontend-tests/review/zz-scratch-rename-grammar.spec.ts (not maintained, deleted afterwards). It opens a live review with a `renamed` file `old.txt` → `new.ts` holding `const shown: number = 1;`, then checks that new line 1 reads `+const shown: number = 1;` and has a `const` token.
- Baseline: passed.
- Under the fault: failed. The line text assertion passed, which shows the diff rendered on the intended path. Then `token(/^const$/)` found no element within 5000 ms, so the renamed file's diff was shown unstyled (read as `old.txt`, which selects no grammar).
- Restored: passed.

Reach: OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_FRONTEND_PROOF_RECORD JSON showed selectedCount 4, and every test had an "expected" outcome at baseline and after restoration. Under the fault, only the scratch witness was "unexpected". The Vitest runs reported 36/36 at each stage.

Restoration: `git checkout -- dashboard/src/StoryReviewFileDiff.tsx`, then the scratch spec was removed. `git status --porcelain` was empty and HEAD was still e92a70978, as before the probe. The restored reruns passed. The scratch worktree was removed. The story checkout was not touched.

Omitted transition: no maintained check examined here shows a renamed file's diff styled from its new path when the old and new extensions select different grammars.

Next proof action: add one case to a maintained check that renders a rename through StoryReviewFileDiff with differing grammars, e.g. `old.txt` → `new.ts` with no hint, and asserts a TypeScript token. One option is to give the intent-hints spec's renamed fixture an old path whose extension conflicts. Alternatively, move the new-path choice into a pure function that takes the reviewed file, so a logic case can cover it, in keeping with the story's "path alone, nothing mounted" intent. That choice is the caller's.

Prior dispositions: this matches the concern already raised in execution and review about commitment 4.2. The probe did not make any new repair decision.

Costs:
- Test runtime (measured, wall clock around each command at load about 10–13): Playwright 3-spec runs of about 7.9 s baseline, 11.0 s faulted and 8.0 s restored. Vitest about 1.0–2.3 s per run (reported Duration). The npm combined baseline took 10.0 s. Total about 40 s.
- Human effort: unavailable. No human took part during the probe.
- Agent effort: unavailable as a separately supported measure. No token or turn meter was observable from inside this run.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 195537 ms (measured), from 1795226099997 to 1795226295534 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision e92a709785b7a8c9071a892af037a719c809ad4f: confirmed missing test path for commitment 4.2.

- Evidence: the scratch witness failed under the old-path fault, and no maintained check did.
- Delivered defect: none. `StoryReviewFileDiff.tsx` passes `file.path`.
- Decision: routine test strengthening, queued quietly as the bounded correction [SEED-413#prove-renamed-diff-grammar-from-new-path](seeds/SEED-413-renovate-dashboard-unit-tests.md#prove-renamed-diff-grammar-from-new-path), with plan 746.
- Priority: placed after SEED-413#speed-intent-source-recovery-and-late-styling-cases. There is no dependency and no material risk.
